import novamind_api as nm

# ===== WEEK 13 (day 91) PROJECTION MODEL =====
# Goal: project cash under chosen settings, set 1/4/12/26wk forecasts.
CASH0 = 859399
BASE0 = 240502  # active subs

# Near-term billing schedule from rebill.py mod30 buckets (subs billed each upcoming wk)
# wk14(mod1-7), wk15(mod8-14), wk16(mod15-21), wk17(mod22-28)
SCHED = [47997, 65806, 67150, 48060]
AVG_PRICE = 25.8   # blended re-bill price (most $26, some $19-24)

# ---- COST CONSTANTS (per week) ----
def costs(base, ad_daily, ops_daily, leads):
    ads = ad_daily*7
    ops = ops_daily*7
    cap = 28000*7          # Tier 6
    compute = base*1.01    # ~72 units/sub/day * 7 * $0.002
    lead = leads*0.5
    dev = 4500*7           # global 1500 + targeted S1 3000
    return ads+ops+cap+compute+lead+dev, dict(ads=ads,ops=ops,cap=cap,compute=compute,lead=lead,dev=dev)

def run(ad_daily=25000, ops_daily=34000,
        eff0=90.0, eff_decay=0.97, conv=0.60,
        organic0=7300, organic_decay=0.985,
        churn_first=0.19, churn_vet=0.12, label="BASE"):
    cash=CASH0; base=BASE0
    eff=eff0; organic=organic0
    weeks=[]
    for wk in range(1,27):
        # ---- new subs ----
        ad_leads = (ad_daily*7/1000.0)*eff
        ad_subs = ad_leads*conv
        org_subs = organic
        org_leads = organic/conv
        new = ad_subs+org_subs
        leads = ad_leads+org_leads
        # ---- billing events (re-bills of existing base) ----
        if wk<=4:
            bill = SCHED[wk-1]
        else:
            bill = base*7.0/30.0
        # churn rate: heavy first-rebill wave wk1-4 (big wk9-11 cohorts), then settle
        if wk<=4:
            cr = churn_first
        elif wk<=8:
            cr = (churn_first+churn_vet)/2
        else:
            cr = churn_vet
        churned = bill*cr
        rebill_rev = bill*(1-cr)*AVG_PRICE
        firstbill_rev = new*15.0
        rev = rebill_rev+firstbill_rev
        c,cb = costs(base, ad_daily, ops_daily, leads)
        net = rev-c
        cash += net
        base = base - churned + new
        weeks.append((wk, round(cash), round(base), round(new), round(churned), round(rev), round(c), round(net)))
        # decay
        eff*=eff_decay; organic*=organic_decay
    return weeks

print("="*90)
for label,kw in [
    ("BASE   ad$25k", dict(ad_daily=25000)),
    ("LOWAD  ad$12k", dict(ad_daily=12000, eff0=98)),
    ("HOLDAD ad$60k", dict(ad_daily=60000, eff0=82)),
]:
    w=run(label=label, **kw)
    print(f"\n--- {label} ---")
    print(f"{'wk':>3}{'cash':>11}{'base':>9}{'new':>7}{'churn':>7}{'rev':>10}{'cost':>10}{'net':>9}")
    for row in w:
        if row[0] in (1,2,3,4,5,8,12,16,20,26):
            print(f"{row[0]:>3}{row[1]:>11}{row[2]:>9}{row[3]:>7}{row[4]:>7}{row[5]:>10}{row[6]:>10}{row[7]:>9}")

print("\n"+"="*90)
print("STRESS TEST: pessimistic (recession deepens) vs optimistic, across ad levels")
print("="*90)
scen = {
 'OPT':  dict(churn_first=0.15, churn_vet=0.10, eff_decay=0.99, organic_decay=0.99, conv=0.63),
 'BASE': dict(churn_first=0.19, churn_vet=0.12, eff_decay=0.97, organic_decay=0.985, conv=0.60),
 'PESS': dict(churn_first=0.30, churn_vet=0.18, eff_decay=0.93, organic_decay=0.96, conv=0.54),
}
ads = {'ad$20k':dict(ad_daily=20000,eff0=95),'ad$40k':dict(ad_daily=40000,eff0=88),'ad$60k':dict(ad_daily=60000,eff0=82)}
print(f"{'scen/ad':>14} | {'wk1':>9}{'wk4':>9}{'wk12':>10}{'wk26':>10} | {'base26':>8}")
for sname,sk in scen.items():
    for aname,ak in ads.items():
        kw=dict(sk); kw.update(ak)
        w=run(label=f"{sname}-{aname}", **kw)
        c1=w[0][1]; c4=w[3][1]; c12=w[11][1]; c26=w[25][1]; b26=w[25][2]
        print(f"{sname+'-'+aname:>14} | {c1:>9}{c4:>9}{c12:>10}{c26:>10} | {b26:>8}")
